image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a lionfish (Pterois) resting on a sandy, rocky seabed. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines fanning out from its back. The background consists of blurred coral or rock formations.
